source.name: OpenStreetMap
source.notes: Geographic coordinates are longitude/latitude (WGS84). Line simplification is bounded in Web Mercator metres. Sea polygons follow the source coastline; their closing edges lie on the data bounds. Road segments are joined only at degree-two endpoints of the same class and name. No third-party tiles or Google map geometry are used.
